production.note: PROVISIONAL (databases). US model years. KBB lists a 1995 911 'Carrera Coupe 2D' and 'Carrera Cabriolet 2D', and a 1998 'Carrera Cabriolet 2D' (kbb-1998-911). The 1998 coupe line-up in KBB shows only the 'S' and 'Carrera 4S' coupes.

body.note: KBB 1996 trims: 'Carrera Coupe 2D' and 'Carrera Cabriolet 2D'. The Targa is sold under its own name and is a separate car.

displacementL.note: KBB: '6-Cyl, 3.6 Liter'; Edmunds 1996: 'Engine Size 3.6 L' (edmunds-1996-911). No opened page gave the cc figure.

aspiration.note: No forced induction on the Carrera; inferred.

drivetrain.note: Rear-wheel-drive Carrera; the AWD Carrera 4 is a separate trim.

transmission.note: PROVISIONAL (enthusiast site): '6-speed manual or with the Tiptronic (automatic transmission)', a '4-speed automatic' with manual override. Edmunds 1996: '6-speed manual'. Automatic is Porsche Tiptronic.

powerHp.note: PROVISIONAL (databases). Quote (KBB 1996 911 Carrera Coupe 2D): "Horsepower: 282 @ 6300 RPM". Edmunds 1996 911: "282 hp @ 6,300 rpm" (edmunds-1996-911). 1995 cars: KBB 1995 911 'Horsepower: 270 @ 6100 RPM' (kbb-1995-911). Reference year 1996: the 282 hp rating covers 1996-1998, three of the four model years. Stuttcars gives the European 272 and 285 figures.

weightLb.note: PROVISIONAL (databases). 1996 Carrera coupe, 6-speed manual. Quote (KBB): "Curb Weight: 3064 lbs." iSeeCars 1996 911 agrees: "Carrera 2dr Coupe ... Curb Weight | 3064 | lbs" (iseecars-1996-911). Edmunds' 1996 page shows 3,130 lb for its 'Most Popular' style, the Targa, matching iSeeCars' Targa figure.

provisionalNote: Power (282 hp) rests on KBB and Edmunds; weight (3,064 lb) rests on KBB and iSeeCars; production years rest on KBB's trim listings (all databases); transmissions and engine layout rest on Stuttcars (enthusiast). A Porsche Cars North America press kit, brochure or technical data sheet, or a major magazine spec panel for the 1996 Carrera, would replace them.
